pre_condition: command is a non-None value for which command_argv(command) returns a list of strings and command_stdin(command) returns either a string or None.
post_condition: Returns a single-line string. The returned string begins with the result of shell-quoting and whitespace-joining every element of command_argv(command) — that is, each element is individually escaped such that the concatenation is a valid shell command-line representation. When command_stdin(command) is not None, the literal suffix " <stdin>" is appended to the result; when command_stdin(command) is None, no suffix is appended. The returned string contains no embedded newline characters.
